# flutter_toasty

> Flutter package for toast notifications. Show toasts from anywhere with static calls (no BuildContext). Six positions, stacked toasts, light/dark theming through a ThemeExtension, and one builder to restyle every toast state.

Import: `import 'package:flutter_toasty/flutter_toasty.dart';`
Docs: README.md. Runnable demo: example/. Changes: CHANGELOG.md.

## Setup (required, once)

Put `ToastyProvider` in the `builder` of the app widget. Do NOT wrap the app with it.

```dart
MaterialApp(            // or MaterialApp.router / CupertinoApp / WidgetsApp
  builder: (context, child) => ToastyProvider(child: child!),
  home: const HomePage(),
)
```

Wrapping `MaterialApp` in `ToastyProvider` fails (no Theme/Localizations/MediaQuery/Overlay for toasts).

`ToastyProvider({required child, ToastyOptions? options, int? maxToasts})`

## Showing toasts

All static on `FlutterToasty`; each returns the toast id (`String`).

```dart
FlutterToasty.info(String message, {title, onClick, onClose, autoDismiss = true,
    dismissDuration = const Duration(seconds: 3), showProgressBar = false,
    progressColor, position});
FlutterToasty.success(...);  // same parameters as info
FlutterToasty.warning(...);  // same parameters as info
FlutterToasty.error(...);    // same parameters as info
FlutterToasty.custom({message, title, child, onClick, onClose, ToastItemOptions? options, position});
FlutterToasty.dismiss(String id);
FlutterToasty.dismissAll();
```

- `position` is a `ToastPosition` (topLeft, topCenter, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomCenter, bottomRight). If omitted, `ToastyOptions.position` is used.
- `custom` needs `message` or `child`. A `child` replaces the toast content entirely and wins over any theme builder. Timing for `custom` (autoDismiss, dismissDuration, showProgressBar) goes through `options`.
- `onClose` runs exactly once per toast however it ends: auto dismiss, close button, tap, `dismiss`, `dismissAll`, or eviction by `maxToasts`.
- Tapping a toast calls `onClick`, then dismisses it if `ToastyOptions.closeOnClick` is true (default).

## Where to configure what

| Need | Use |
| --- | --- |
| Look (colors, icon, text styles, shape, builder), light/dark aware | `ToastyTheme` in `ThemeData.extensions` |
| Behavior (position, width, pauseOnHover, closeOnClick, maxToasts) | `ToastyProvider(options: ToastyOptions(...), maxToasts: n)` |
| Timing / callbacks for one toast | arguments of `FlutterToasty.info/...` |
| One-off look for one toast | `options:` of `FlutterToasty.custom` |

Look precedence, highest first: `options` passed to `custom` > `ToastyTheme` > `ToastyOptions.itemOptions` (deprecated) > built-in defaults. A state left null in `ToastyTheme` falls through.

## Theming

```dart
MaterialApp(
  theme: ThemeData(extensions: [
    ToastyTheme(
      success: ToastItemOptions(backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade600),
      error: ToastItemOptions(backgroundColor: Colors.red.shade600),
    ),
  ]),
  darkTheme: ThemeData.dark().copyWith(extensions: [
    ToastyTheme(
      success: ToastItemOptions(backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade900),
      error: ToastItemOptions(backgroundColor: Colors.red.shade900),
    ),
  ]),
  builder: (context, child) => ToastyProvider(child: child!),
)
```

- `ToastyTheme({success, error, warning, info, custom, builder})`; `ToastyTheme.all(options, {builder})` applies one set to every state.
- `ToastItemOptions` fields: backgroundColor, titleTextStyle, contentTextStyle, icon, centerIcon, autoDismiss, dismissDuration, showProgressBar, progressColor, showLeadingIcon, showCloseIcon, shape.
- GOTCHA: a theme state's options replace that state's whole look. Fields you don't set take the constructor defaults (white background, no icon), not the built-in per-state ones. Set background, text styles and icon together.
- From a theme, only visual fields are used. `autoDismiss`, `dismissDuration`, `showProgressBar`, `progressColor` always come from the call that showed the toast.
- Toasts already on screen restyle live when the theme mode or extension changes.

## One design for all states (builder)

```dart
ToastyTheme(
  builder: (context, ToastData data) => Row(children: [
    data.options.icon,
    Expanded(child: Text(data.message, style: data.options.contentTextStyle)),
    IconButton(icon: const Icon(Icons.close), onPressed: data.dismiss),
  ]),
)
```

- `ToastData`: `id`, `type` (ToastType), `title`, `message`, `options` (resolved ToastItemOptions), `dismiss()`.
- The builder replaces only the content inside the card. The card (background, shape, elevation), progress bar, hover pause and tap handling still come from the per-state options. For a card-less design set the state's `backgroundColor` to transparent.
- `FlutterToasty.custom(child: ...)` overrides the builder. A message-only `custom` uses it.
- If the builder throws, the default content is shown and the error is logged.
- There is no builder parameter on `ToastyProvider`; the theme is the only place.

## Behavior to rely on

- Toasts at the same position stack: newest in front at full size, older ones peek out behind as cards (their content shows when they reach the front).
- Only the front toast's dismiss timer runs. Newest goes first; each older one then gets its full `dismissDuration`. A burst of 3 default toasts clears in about 9 seconds.
- `maxToasts` (default 3) is per position; the oldest is removed on overflow.
- `pauseOnHover` pauses the front toast's timer while hovered.
- Each toast is announced to screen readers.
- Positions each have an independent stack and timers.
- Default position: `ToastyProvider` without `options` uses `bottomCenter`. A `ToastyOptions()` you construct yourself without `position` uses `bottomRight`.
- `ToastyOptions.dismissDuration`, `animationCurve` and `animationDuration` are currently NOT used. Set the duration per call with `dismissDuration:`; the default is 3 seconds.

## Common mistakes

- Wrapping the app instead of using `MaterialApp.builder` (see Setup).
- Expecting `ToastyOptions` to style toasts: it is behavior only; use `ToastyTheme`.
- Setting a partial `ToastItemOptions` on a theme state and losing its icon/colors (see Gotcha).
- Passing a `child` to `custom` and expecting the builder to run.
- Expecting position/duration/progress-bar changes to affect toasts already on screen: they apply to the next toast.
- Using `ToastManager` directly: it is internal (not exported). Use `FlutterToasty`.
